reason: A workspace sticky-notes plugin for creating, editing, organizing, and deleting Markdown notes stored in workspace-specific dsh-notes directories.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 工作区中创建、编辑、管理和删除以 Markdown 文件保存的多张便签。
summaries.en: Manage multiple workspace notes by creating, editing, and deleting Markdown files through a compact session-header interface.

capabilities: Create, edit, list, and delete Markdown notes
Read and write note files within registered workspaces
Expose local HTTP endpoints for note operations
Switch between registered workspaces in the note interface
